name: Rwag
summary: In the Den, Rwag teaches newcomers the first steps of a rogue's craft. The orc trains newly arrived orcs and trolls in stealth, subterfuge, and dirty fighting in Durotar's Valley of Trials, under the Horde's watch.

sections.title: Shadows of the Valley
sections.body:
Deep in the Den, Rwag trains young rogues, cutpurses, and thieves before they leave the cave and venture into Durotar. The new Horde honors martial skill and valor in battle. Yet Rwag knows subtlety, poisons, and a well-placed dagger can still mean survival in the unforgiving desert.

Rwag keeps watch over affairs in the Valley. He distrusts the dark practitioners sheltering in the cave, especially the warlock Nartok.

faq.answer: Rwag trains orc and troll rogues inside the Den in the Valley of Trials. There, he teaches them the first steps of their training in Durotar.
Rwag can be found deep inside the Den, a cavern cut into the rocky cliffs of Durotar's Valley of Trials. Several other class trainers are there too.

faq.q: What does Rwag think of the warlocks in the Den?
faq.answer: Rwag distrusts the warlocks who share the Den, especially Nartok. He watches the warlock closely.
Rwag trains rogues in early techniques such as Eviscerate. At the Shattered Hand's request, he watches new recruits and passes along anything the Hand might need to know about them.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll rogue in the Valley of Trials, you meet Rwag as your first mentor in skulduggery. He teaches early offensive techniques and how to decipher secret ciphers.
As an orc, you see in Rwag the practical edge of survival. Even in Thrall's honorable new Horde, shadows and cold steel remain vital.
